_: The town's fake answers. Every word is invented; the demo never reaches Supabase.

rows.name: Pat
rows.body: The old diner counter with the wobbly stools and the pie case by the door, one last Sunday with the whole crew.
The record shop that let you play anything on the back turntable as long as you wanted to stay.

rows.name: Jo
rows.body: The movie house downtown. Sticky floors and all.

rows.name: Sam
rows.body: The third bench along the water, late, once the wind drops and the ferry lights come out across the lake.
Window seat at the coffee place on a rainy morning, with nowhere you have to be for hours.

rows.name: Lee
rows.body: The five-way one by the hill. Everyone waves everyone else through and nobody moves at all.

rows.name: Ari
rows.body: A bowl of soup on a ferry in the rain, somewhere between two places I can no longer name.
The place with the line out the door, and it isn't close, and I will not be taking questions.

rows.name: Dee
rows.body: Anywhere with a griddle and a regular who calls you hon.

rows.name: Mo
rows.body: As long as it takes, as long as they actually finish the bike lane this time around.
